promotions.set_note: Live-verified 2026-07-02: WP lead states verbatim 'Economic geography is the subfield of human geography'; Wikidata Q187097 P279 subclass-of Q12831143 (human geography); OECD FORD 5.7 'Social and economic geography' (captured 2026-06-11). Co-equal cross-listing with the existing reviewed economic-geography→economics membership (cross-listing v1 — WP lead itself notes it 'can also be considered a subfield or method in economics'). Edge promotion policy v1 structural tier; supported.

Live-verified 2026-07-02: WP lead states 'Decision theory or the theory of rational choice is a branch of probability, economics, and analytic philosophy'; Wikidata Q177571 P279 includes Q8134 (economics); LCC HB615-715 'Entrepreneurship. Risk and uncertainty' inside HB 'Economic theory. Demography' (live-reproduced from lcco_h.pdf). Clears the 2026-06-11 'partial fit' hold with direct claim-stating evidence. Co-equal cross-listing with the reviewed part_of→philosophy (the WP lead names both memberships, plus probability — a probability/statistics co-listing remains an open candidate). Edge promotion policy v1 structural tier; supported.

UDC 343.9 'Criminology. Criminal sciences. Criminalistics' nested under 343 'Criminal law. Penal offences' under 34 'Law. Jurisprudence' (captured 2026-06-11); Britannica: European universities 'treat criminology as part of legal education', and the Institute of Criminology 'is part of the law faculty of the University of Cambridge' (snapshot 2026-06-02). Record-not-resolve: Britannica's definition frames criminology as the study of the *nonlegal* aspects of crime — the law membership is classificatory/institutional, co-equal with the sociology membership (cross-listing v1); together the pair records the field's genuinely split academic placement. Edge promotion policy v1 structural tier; supported.

LCC HV6001-7220.5 'Criminology' within Class H social sciences (Subclass HV 'Social pathology. Social and public welfare. Criminology', incl. HV6035-6197 criminal anthropology/criminal sociology — live-reproduced 2026-07-02 from lcco_h.pdf); Britannica: criminological research and teaching 'usually divided between departments of sociology or social administration, law faculties' (snapshot 2026-06-02); WP lead: criminology 'draws primarily upon the research of sociologists'. Record-not-resolve: sources frame criminology as an interdisciplinary social/behavioural science rather than strictly sociology-contained — the membership is co-equal with law (cross-listing v1). Edge promotion policy v1 structural tier; supported.

sources.quote: Economic geography is the subfield of human geography that studies economic activity and factors affecting it.
P279 (subclass of) → Q12831143 (human geography); also Q524273 (social geography), Q8134 (economics)
OECD FORD 5.7 'Social and economic geography' (recorded capture, B-track prevalidation 2026-06-11)

Decision theory or the theory of rational choice is a branch of probability, economics, and analytic philosophy that uses expected utility and probability to model how individuals would behave rationally under uncertainty.

HB615-715 Entrepreneurship. Risk and uncertainty — inside Subclass HB, HB1-3840 Economic theory. Demography
